sentences.en: Still other healing modalities such as homeopathic, Chinese and Ayurvedic medicine may use herbs or plants, but do not use the same quantities or types as herbal medicine.

sentences.en: The physical therapy modalities used for dogs are essentially the same as those used for people.

sentences.en: For counting there is an additional active network in the left hemisphere also common to the two modalities.

sentences.en: Recognize the strength of multiple training modalities and don't be seduced by the lure of monolithic technology based solutions.

sentences.en: In particular the missed deadline on agricultural modalities, which was more than missed and the text that was prepared arrived stillborn.

sentences.en: Only when treatable causes have been excluded should other treatment modalities for chronic pain be considered.

sentences.en: The acquisition of Switchboard by Infospace should accelerate consolidation across multiple modalities of the Yellow and White Pages.
